It is understood that LLNS may request substantiating information as part of the application for payment approval process. The Subcontractor shall furnish the appropriate data to justify dollar amounts or percentages complete, off-site stored products, change orders, or other items in question. As part of a progress payment, LLNS may authorize payment for material delivered on the site and preparatory work done. Payment for material delivered to the Subcontractor at locations other than the site may also be allowed if: 1. Material is delivered to a remote location which is specifically authorized by this Subcontract; and 2. The Subcontractor furnishes satisfactory evidence that it has acquired title to such material and that the material will be used to perform this Subcontract. Along with each request for a progress payment, the Subcontractor shall furnish a completed Application and Certification for Payment for the period. Requests for progress payments submitted without this document shall be denied. D. When LLNS approves an Application and Certification for Payment, LLNS will retain 10 percent of the payment amount. However, if satisfactory progress has not been made, LLNS may retain up to 15 percent of the amount of any payment until satisfactory progress has been achieved. When satisfactory progress has been re-established, LLNS may release the excess retention for payment. Schedule of Articles Subcontract No. B624801 Page 6 of 12 (DM-211; 02/01/17) LLNL-TR-2004972 E. LLNS may withhold payment to the Subcontractor to the extent necessary to protect LLNS upon the occurrence of any one or more of the following events. 1. Any failure of the Subcontractor to comply fully with any requirement of this Subcontract including, but not limited to, the following. a. Failure to adhere to, or recover to, the proposed construction schedule. b. Failure to make prompt payment to lower tier subcontractors for labor, materials, or services related to the work for which the Subcontractor has been paid by LLNS. c. Failure to rectify defective, omitted, non-conforming, or unauthorized work. d. Failure to comply with the DAVIS-BACON ACT and the related labor clauses identified in the GENERAL PROVISIONS, including, without limitation, timely submission of Certified Payrolls. 2. The filing, delivery, or recording of any claim, lien, stop notice, or similar action against LLNS or the work. 3. Any damage caused to a third party by the Subcontractor by reason of negligent acts of the Subcontractor where such acts are related to the work under this Subcontract. LLNS reserves the right to determine the amount and degree of withholding, provided that the withholding shall not be unreasonable. LLNS will pay withheld amounts promptly upon removal of the grounds for such withholding. F. When the work is substantially complete, LLNS may retain from previously withheld amounts or future progress payments that amount LLNS considers adequate for protection of LLNS and may release to the Subcontractor all the remaining withheld funds.
